snippet.title: Shotgun Mario 64 - RELEASE & DOWNLOAD! | SM64 ROM Hack
snippet.description:
Blast your way through good ol' Mario 64 with a SHOTGUN!  A completely new shotgun mechanic complete with firing, a jump-boost, an aiming mode with a crosshair, and many unique interactions to make for a fresh SM64 experience.  This initial version game took around 200 hours of work to make.
Be sure to check back regularly, as I update this game pretty often!  From new interactions & bug fixes to completely new dynamics.
* ParaLLEl with its native plug-in is the way to play this game.  This also supports dual analog for aiming mode when using ParaLLEl.
* I'm not working on making this better on N64, don't play it on there, it's unstable

*** DOWNLOAD: https://romhacking.com/hack/shotgun-mario-64 ***

Like what I make? The best way to help out is if you want to spread the word and tell your friends about my mods!
My major hack demo: https://youtu.be/XfAkOiU9s7w
